description: This file contains monkey patch functions for the ebookmeta library, extending or modifying its classes and functions related to ebook metadata management.

classes.name: Epub2
classes.description: A class from the ebookmeta library representing an EPUB ebook, extended with monkey patched methods.

methods.name: set_author_list
methods.description: Sets the list of authors in the ebook metadata, removing existing author nodes with role 'aut' or no role.

methods.name: set_description
methods.description: Sets the description metadata of the ebook.

methods.name: set_metadata
methods.description: Populates the ebook metadata fields from a provided meta object, including title, description, authors, series, language, tags, translator, cover data, and publish info if format is FB2.
